title: Rail Fast Checkout — One Human Question, Owners Do The Rest
purpose: After the buyer has picked a train/seat (prepare_checkout delegation), carry one valid selection through booking review, protected checkout and issuance tracking with a single consolidated human interaction — using only existing commands and owner-issued handles.
when_to_use: The buyer explicitly picked a train/seat or delegated selection under rules, and you hold a bookable option with booking_offer.selection_token from itpay-rail-exact or itpay-rail-smart.
Do NOT use for a plain schedule query (compare goal) — present one preferred option plus up to two alternatives and wait instead.

notes: Fill <token> with the current result's booking_offer.selection_token; add selection.seat_type when the buyer picked a class. Create the file yourself under /tmp — the buyer never sees a path.
Never reconstruct legs JSON when a token is available; the owner derives authoritative legs and re-quotes live.

steps.read: human_action.context.review carries legs, seat_options, draft_revision and notice_version.
steps.ask_human_once: Show the itinerary, seat options and the seat-preference disclaimer in one message; collect passengers count, seat_type, one seat preference per passenger slot, party_preference, and agreement to the notice_version terms.
steps.web_review: If the review projection carries an official web entry (handoff.url in the envelope), prefer it: open it for the buyer and wait there; the chat fallback remains valid if the page is unavailable.
steps.submit: itpay services action <execution_id> --action workflow:confirm_booking --actor-type human --status approved --input-json /tmp/itpay-review.json --json
notes: draft_revision must equal the current server value; booking_review_changed means re-read services next and resubmit, never bump locally.
accept_non_guaranteed is true only when the buyer actually agreed; never fabricate a human approval.
Passenger names, ID numbers and phones are NOT in this input — they belong to the protected checkout page.

steps.read: services next returns checkout_required/payment_pending with handoff.url (the protected checkout page).
notes: Show or open the checkout exactly once; pass --viewer mobile when the buyer is on a phone.
The buyer completes identity and payment on that page (Path B — no forced separate login). Payment handoff is not payment success; wallet return is not confirmation.
Issuance is asynchronous — paid does not mean ticketed. Keep reading the SAME execution; never create a replacement.
On issued, report the order state; if seat details are still syncing, advise checking 12306 instead of re-querying.

never: Never build legs JSON from visible result fields while a selection_token exists.
Never run a second services run for the same selection — repeat submission restores the same execution.
Never ask for passenger identity, verification codes, or payment details in chat.
Never claim payment equals issuance, or a displayed handoff equals human approval.
Never invent command flags, action types, revisions or tokens; copy server-issued handles verbatim.
